meta.units: cm, heart frame (origin MV centre, Z = LV long axis base→apex, X = toward the RV/septum, Y = inferior-posterior)
notes: Outer surface only (epicardium + great vessels); septal AHA segments appear only where the septum reaches the surface (IV grooves). A 4-chamber cut needs its own export or a clip plane + cap.

territory = standard AHA map (Cerqueira 2002); territoryModel = nearest branch of this model's own right-dominant tree; vessel/vesselT let a lab infarct everything downstream of a clot (vessel in the clot's subtree and vesselT > clot position).
Vessels: draw tubes from the centrelines with displayR (thicker than life, tappable); r0/r1 are the true radii (angiography).
Teaching model: verify territories and branch positions against an expert.

heart._note: Right-handed. All cardiac landmarks/shapes below are in this frame. Engine transform: p_patient = origin + x_h*X + y_h*Y + z_h*Z.

axes.X: from LV toward RV / septum (≈ anterior-right): the 'S' axis
axes.Y: inferior-posterior (diaphragmatic side, coronary sinus side). -Y = anterior-superior (LVOT/aorta side)

heart.teachingNote: A4C plane ≈ X–Z plane (Y≈0). Tilting the beam toward -Y opens the LVOT (A5C); toward +Y shows the coronary sinus (pitfall).

frames._matrixNote: column-major 4×4 (three.js Matrix4.fromArray): p_body = heartToBody · p_heart (cm); p_H3 = heartToH3 · p_heart (heart-3d-model units, 1 unit ≈ 7.08 cm)
